module: Flowgraph node "Set Fuel Level" (category once_f_duration, career color/icon). Sets a vehicle's fuel level to the same percentage in all its tanks. Inputs: vehId (number, otherwise player vehicle 0), mult (number 0-1, fraction of the maximum). First requests the tanks' energy (core_vehicleBridge 'energyStorage'), then runs the setEnergyStorageEnergy action with maxEnergy * mult for each tank; the state becomes finished.
notes: The local variable allowedTypes (gasoline, diesel, electricEnergy) and fuelType are unused: all tanks are set.
The code does not check that mult is non-nil.

_executionStarted.desc: Calls onNodeReset when the graph starts.

onNodeReset.desc: Resets the received data, the send flag and the duration state ('inactive').

workOnce.desc: Finds the vehicle, requests the energy data and switches to the 'started' state.

work.desc: Once the data has arrived, sets each tank to maxEnergy*mult and switches to 'finished'.
